snippet.title: REX Release 0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD Here! - https://www.rexbuild.site/downloads

At longer last, here's the proper launch to REX Release 0! The project born from the end of PMEX REMIX. Welcome to the start of Smash REX proper.

A huge shoutout to everyone involved in making REX a reality! Both directly and indirectly. A credits list is in the works with the release of REX.

Custom Havok can be found here! -- https://github.com/exul-anima/Blackened-Bones

Thanks again, and welcome to REX.
- The REX Development Team
____________

Theme used for trailer - Zardonic ft. The Qemists - Takeover (Zardonic & Fickle6 VIP) - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=shJUUJjxZ38
